summary: Manitowoc County tower at Collins Marsh, moved from Silver Lake, Michigan; listed standing, opened only when someone is on site; no build history found.

access.note: Climbing allowed only when someone is on site to open the tower (2019 post).

visit.trail_note: Neustadter Nature Center, 20021 County Road JJ, Collins, WI 54207. From State Highway 10 or 151, take County Road W to County Road JJ.

events.note: Moved from Silver Lake, Michigan to Collins Marsh; the year of the move is not given in the sources read.
Dedication of the tower and the Neustadter Nature Center set for Sept. 29, 2019, in honor of James Koeppel and RD Peters.

evidence.supports: listed as a standing tower relocated from Silver Lake, Michigan, at Collins Marsh, Manitowoc County, latitude 44.08286
evidence.quote: (Relocated Silver Lake, MI) Manitowoc 44.08286 -87.96828 Tower Standing

evidence.supports: county list prints the latitude as 48.08286
tower taken down in the Upper Peninsula and hauled to Collins Marsh using three trucks
evidence.quote: Jim was responsible for the taking the tower down in the Upper U.P. and using three trucks to haul it down to Collins Marsh.

evidence.supports: RD Peters helped put the tower back up on the site
evidence.quote: RD Peters helped with the placing the tower back up at the location on Collins Marsh.

evidence.supports: dedication set for Sept. 29, 2019, in honor of James Koeppel and RD Peters
evidence.quote: On Sunday Sept. 29th, 2019 the property around the Collins Marsh are will be buzzing with Humans, not wildlife as the New Nature center will be dedicated and the Fire Tower will be dedicated in the Honor of James Koeppel and RD Peters.

evidence.supports: visitors may climb the tower only when someone is there to open it
evidence.quote: The fire tower will now be allowing individuals to climb it when someone is around to open it up to all.

evidence.supports: address of the Neustadter Nature Center at 20021 County Road JJ
evidence.quote: look for Neustadter Nature Center, 20021 County Road JJ, Collins, WI 54207 at Collins Marsh.

evidence.supports: directions by County Road W from State Highway 10 or 151
evidence.quote: Using State Highway 151 between Valders, WI and Chilton, WI you take County Road W North to County Road JJ and turn Right.

evidence.supports: directions also name State Highway 10 (between Appleton and Manitowoc), then County Road W south to County Road JJ
evidence.quote: If you plan on driving out there to see the wildlife or climb the tower, use State Highway 10, between Appleton and Manitowoc.

corrections.current: None relocated (Moved from Silver Lake, Michigan to Collins Marsh.)
corrections.proposed: relocated: moved from Silver Lake, Michigan to Collins Marsh
corrections.why: The record's text says none were relocated and then describes a move; the association lists the tower as relocated from Silver Lake, MI.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The association's county list prints latitude 48.08286; its state list and this record give 44.08286, which fits Manitowoc County. The 48 is treated as a typo.

sources.title: Collins Marsh Neustadter Nature Center and Fire Tower, Come see the wildlife

notes_for_editor: The Michigan origin rests on the FFLA entry alone; no Michigan source was reached (the michiganfiretower.com homepage has no Silver Lake match). The 2019 post says the tower came down in the Upper Peninsula but names no Silver Lake site, so it is unconfirmed whether that is the same Silver Lake; left open. Relocation year, builder, build date and design are not found. The county list's 48.08286 is treated as a typo. Access and visit facts come from a 2019 post and may be out of date; confirm with the Neustadter Nature Center before a visit. Two web searches used.
